series.label: Budget law: total budgeted revenue
series.notes: Ministry of Finance, Annual Budget Documents (budget notes, summaries, Citizen Budget editions). Budget = the budget law as voted, in LBP billion, excluding Treasury advances (e.g. to EDL) and net Treasury operations unless stated. Documents found on the MoF site cover 1997-2005 and 2018-2026 only; no budget law figures were extracted for 1993-1996, 2006-2017 (MoF lists government proposals or circulars only), 2021 or 2023 revenue. 1998 is approximate (budget report: about LL 4,600 billion). 2024-2026 laws are balanced on paper (calculated deficit 0%), excluding EDL advances and other Treasury items.

series.label: Budget law: total budgeted expenditure
series.notes: Ministry of Finance, Annual Budget Documents (budget notes, summaries, Citizen Budget editions). Budget = the budget law as voted, in LBP billion, excluding Treasury advances (e.g. to EDL) and net Treasury operations unless stated. Documents found on the MoF site cover 1997-2005 and 2018-2026 only; no budget law figures were extracted for 1993-1996, 2006-2017 (MoF lists government proposals or circulars only), 2021 or 2023 revenue. 2019 is derived (revenue 18,782.9 plus deficit 4,322.6); 2023 is the 2023 law total (Citizen Budget 2024, comparison table). 2019 and 2020 laws were voted with Treasury advances to EDL on top.

series.label: Budget law: budgeted deficit (-) / surplus
series.notes: Ministry of Finance, Annual Budget Documents (budget notes, summaries, Citizen Budget editions). Documents found on the MoF site cover 1997-2005 and 2018-2026 only; no budget law figures were extracted for 1993-1996, 2006-2017 (MoF lists government proposals or circulars only), 2021 or 2023 revenue. 2022 is derived (revenue 29,985 minus expenditure 40,873); the others are stated in the documents. series.label: Commercial banks: resident private-sector deposits in foreign currency
series.notes: Association of Banks in Lebanon (ABL) 'Key Indicators' bulletins, from BDL data. Consolidated balance sheet of commercial banks, end of month, foreign-currency items translated at the legal rate in force (LBP 89,500 per USD from 31 Jan 2024 per BDL Circular 167; LBP 15,000 for Dec 2023), so USD amounts are accounting values, not market values. Covers Dec 2023 and Sep 2024 - Jul 2026 only (bulletins found); latest figure in this build is the last month listed.

series.label: BDL FC Gross Reserves (end of period)
series.notes: ABL Key Indicators, from BDL. Definition revised from January 2024 (BDL Central Council decision 37/20/24 of 13 Sep 2024): foreign assets include monetary gold, non-resident foreign securities and deposits with correspondents; they exclude Lebanese sovereign bonds and BDL FX loans to resident banks. Not comparable with older BDL gross reserves.
